verdict: FRAGILE: selected parameters drift across folds — treat live config with caution
live_config_note: Although per-fold optimum drifts (verdict FRAGILE by strict identical-selection criterion), the FROZEN live config (ADX20/SL3/TP3+retest) OUT-PERFORMED each fold's walk-forward-selected config on that fold's own out-of-sample test window (2022: 12.48 vs 1.94; 2023: 1.27 vs 0.59; 2024-26: 2.48 vs 2.20).
